headline: The Treasury places 6,273 million in medium- and long-term debt and raises the yield offered to investors - Crónica de Cantabria
summary: The Spanish Treasury awarded 6,273.3 million euros in bonds and state obligations and raised the yield offered to investors. The marginal rate on 15-year index-linked bonds set a record.
why: Government bond auctions set the borrowing cost for the Spanish state, and yields serve as a benchmark for pricing Spanish and wider euro-area debt.
